description: The sleeping Pandava camp after the war's end. Tents form narrow corridors. Darkness creates fog-of-war. Ashwatthama (KAURAVA) enters from the north. The player controls evacuation forces — surviving is secondary to the canonical total wipe.

tile_overrides.note: Dhrishtadyumna sleeps here. When Ashwatthama enters, trigger-dhrishtadyumna-death fires seq_night_slaughter.
The central campfire — dim visibility radius 2 tiles.

PANDAVA.note: Scattered sleeping forces. Player controls surviving Pandava camp guards.

KAURAVA.note: Ashwatthama enters alone from the north. He is unkillable (chiranjivi + rudra-possession traits).

fog_of_war.note: Night fight. Units can only see 2 tiles. Ashwatthama's position is hidden until he enters visibility range.

special_mechanics.ashwatthama_immortality: chiranjivi + rudra-possession make Ashwatthama invulnerable. RudraAuraDamage(50) applies to all adjacent units each turn. Healing fully each turn (trigger-ashwatthama-mani-heal, EVERY_TURN, SYSTEM_HEAL_FULL).
special_mechanics.evacuation_goal: Player goal is to get as many Pandava units to the south edge (y=19) as possible before turn 15.
special_mechanics.canonical_outcome: Total camp wipe is canonical (fail_on_deviation: false). Surviving is a moral small victory, not a plot change.

directive_notes.final_trigger: trigger-brahmashira-standoff fires at turn 15 → seq_brahmashira_standoff VNScene end state.
